arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && for f in s_frames s_scatter s_bigframes; do echo "== $f"; python3 - <<EOF
import subprocess,sys,time,resource,os
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],stdin=open('/app/work/$f.json','rb'),stdout=open('/app/work/$f.out','wb'),stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/app/submission')
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%(time.time()-t0),'cpu %.2f'%u.ru_utime,'maxrss MB %.1f'%(u.ru_maxrss/1024), 'stderr', p.stderr.decode()[:200])
EOF
ls -l /app/work/$f.out; done
